description:
Clipboard-first PGP encryption for desktop.

KeychainPGP is clipboard-first PGP encryption for the desktop, built with Rust, Tauri v2 and Svelte 5. Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify from your clipboard and manage your OpenPGP keys, with automatic keyserver discovery and uploads.
What's Changed
- Automatic Keyserver Discovery and Uploads by @superkelvint in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/38
